limits: Only public pages, seen as a logged-out visitor, were examined. Private, deleted and logged-in content is invisible.
Posting times are the times the pages declare (they can be edited, rounded or in another time zone).
All relationships between accounts are hypotheses until confirmed by authorised evidence.
Authorised evidence means records held by platforms or devices, obtainable only through lawful process by the police or a court.

authorised_evidence.upload_logs: Platform upload records for the post: exact upload time, the IP address and device used (lawful request by the police to the platform).
authorised_evidence.registration: Account registration data (email, phone, creation time and IP) held by the platform (lawful request).
authorised_evidence.original_file: The file as originally uploaded, before the platform re-encoded it, with its metadata (platform, lawful request).
authorised_evidence.repost_graph: The platform's own record of who shared or re-posted whom (platform, lawful request).
authorised_evidence.messages: Direct messages or group membership between the accounts (court order / lawful request; never obtainable from public pages).
authorised_evidence.device: Examination of a seized device or camera against the files (police forensic examination).
authorised_evidence.archive: An earlier archived capture of either post (Internet Archive / other archives: public, no authority needed).
authorised_evidence.provider: Account and usage records from the AI tool's provider (lawful request).
